claims.claim: Jiang says his move from English literature into geopolitics comes from a general compulsion to keep learning until he can satisfy his curiosity about history, politics, and any field he thinks matters.

He says elite investment in the occult is one reason he wants to study sex magic, demonic possession, reincarnation, and related ideas, because he assumes there must be some logic behind elite attention to them.
Jiang says he distrusted the rush toward COVID vaccination and credits Bret Weinstein's analysis as part of why he followed the issue skeptically.
claims.temporal_scope: Retrospective judgment about the COVID period, voiced on 2026-06-13.

claims.claim: He says the contemporary food system is mass-manufactured and controlled by food corporations whose purpose is to make people unhealthy.
Jiang says education is the way to remain peaceful in a chaotic world because greater understanding of the universe, the present situation, and the direction of events makes a person more relaxed.
He accepts that the deeper problem is not boomers as a generation but powerful people who refuse to relinquish power.
Jiang predicts the attempted beheading in Belfast marks a tipping point after which public anger in the UK will be very difficult to calm and will develop into civil war.
He attributes the forecasted unrest to a bad economy, generalized anger, and what he describes as excessive immigration pressure.
claims.temporal_scope: Causal diagnosis attached to his UK forecast on 2026-06-13.
